_restored_comment: RESTORED 2026-10-15 (bean folio-assistant-63q4; owner: "Fix trust and immz"). 556b5bf1 removed this declaration on 2026-10-14 when the repository moved to the smart-hiv shape (owner: "Smart-hiv doesn't need its own harness. It can just define index.config.json and reference smart-base as a dependency"). That shape still governs how THIS repository mounts smart-base: index.config.json does it, and this file declares no remoteMounts. What it cannot do is let folio-assistant mount smart-immunizations as an instance, because remote-mount finds an instance only by its `<name>.json` declaration. Restored from 556b5bf1^, at the repository root where it was, plus its library/ (below).
title: WHO SMART Guidelines — Immunizations
description: The WHO SMART Guidelines immunizations implementation guide (FHIR IG source under input/), as a harnessed instance of smart-base: its L1 library (the DAK's Component 1 sources and L1 knowledge graph, and the measles L1-scenario example moved here from smart-base).

directories.description: L1 source content for this DAK: one `<bib-slug>/` per ingested WHO publication (`sections/*.md`, `structure.json`, `manifest.jsonld`, `blocks/`), the Component 1 L1 knowledge graph in `9789240099456-eng/smart-kg-l1-dak-references.json`, and `l1-recommendation-scenarios/measles/`, the worked example moved here from smart-base (owner, 2026-10-14, Q2 of the folio-assistant#2529 review: "Move it"). The id is `library`, the CONVENTIONAL one, so this entry overrides the default rather than joining it. Declared EXPLICITLY although the default already resolves `library/` in this checkout: remote-mount reads only declared directories, so without this entry an index mounting smart-immunizations mounts none of it, and gen-instance-contexts reads no document to build `ns/context/v1.jsonld` from.

_builtAtPublish_comment: Owner, 2026-10-14 (B1; schemas/built-at-publish.ts in cat-harness). This instance's JSON-LD @context is generated by `jsonld:contexts` (cat-harness-tools scripts/gen-instance-contexts.ts) from the prefixes and content-context terms its documents use, flattened with the prefix tables of every instance it needs. Those tables are read at the CHECKOUT's pins, not at pins this instance's commit names, so no commit of it can hold the file current: it is built at publish and never committed (bean folio-assistant-63q4).
